I rewrote the PWA check proposal's `requirements.md`. Its first deliverable item was one 110-word bullet, over the 60-word limit, so I split it into four tick-box questions. They cover the manifest and service worker, `/push/key`, a headless test push, and Android installability. `Server/text-check.mjs` flagged nothing, so the rest was already clear. I did not shoot any pages, since the proposal has no `page.js`.

I logged the change as a "rewrote" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. I did not message the mastermind that owns the brief. This was one pass, so I'm stopping here.
